name: virtualdj-mcp
description: FastMCP 3.4.4 server for VirtualDJ automation. 12 consolidated portmanteau tools for playback, mixing, stems separation, Plex integration, and real-time audio analysis.
author: Sandra
features: Deck control (play, pause, stop, seek, volume, AI lyrics)
Mixing tools (crossfader, sync, EQ reset, headphone mix, 122+ FX)
Library management (advanced local searches, audio feature extraction)
Stems (Vocal/Instrumental isolation, acapella mode, sampler recording)
Beatgrid (loop, loop rolls, fluid variable grids, BPM tap)
Plex integration (direct cloud music library queries and local loading)
System diagnostics (connected status probes, prefab visual cards)

license: VirtualDJ Pro (required for Network Control plugin)
